fields.FIR_Description: On 2026-04-10 around 21:05 hrs, it was reported that a person offering to buy an item listed online asked the complainant to approve a UPI request, following which Rs. 12,000 was withdrawn. Ravi Gopal reported the matter orally at Erode North PS; the contact number given was 9000000098. Funds were reportedly sent to the account reference SYN-ACC-100041. The complaint mentions Ajith Nathan, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000297, in connection with the events. Items referenced in the complaint: digital documents. The account SYN-ACC-100041 was also referenced in FIR-2026-00371, so the two matters may be potentially related.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly posed as an online buyer and requested payment approval.
fields.Keywords: UPI fraud, online payment, suspect, apartment complex, night, mobile number, receiving account, digital document
